facts.fact: 野餐（兑现正午沙丘约定）：又把 Veronica 丢在家——她抿嘴阴沉像被留下的狗；还没告密（Rue 推测两种怕）；「I would not wish to give my mother unfavorable news」
Edward 问「怎么认识 Anne 的」——Rue 用真相碎片串谎（裁缝铺版）；Anne 的笑太完整「too full of joy to spoil」——要让幸福刻进她皮肤
facts.anchor: It is how all lies should be told

facts.fact: Anne 拆台自曝（她告诉 Edward 被救之事）；Edward 追问 host——「Your mother was the host, if I am not mistaken?」Rue 差点噎住；Oren 猛坐起「eyes storm dark」
facts.anchor: There ought not be lies in our marriage

facts.fact: Edward 点破谎：「I hear the damn bastard got what he deserved」+Anne 不在宴会——Anne 微摇头（他不知她去过 Folkehaven）；「No lies, indeed.」
facts.anchor: Anne wasn’t at the dinner party.

facts.fact: Edward 酸话「你不像吃茶点的物种」；Oren 起身被 Rue 按肘压住；她再塞一块糕点咧嘴：「我正是这种生物」
facts.anchor: And yet, I am such a creature.

facts.fact: Anne 调停「不能一口气谢恩、又谴责我的朋友，不公平」；Edward「感恩但仍警惕交易的魔鬼」；Rue 举杯：「It would be wise to be.」
facts.anchor: still be wary of the devils bargained with.

facts.fact: Rue 内白：与 Edward 无友谊可言；Anne 用甜笑与对恐怖的认可填她一块空洞，Oren（手贴她背、下巴绷紧、像要为她把世界暴打一顿）填剩下的——「I am full.」
facts.anchor: Oren fills the remains. I am full.

facts.fact: 风暴骤起 Oren 握手不放（anchoring）；Anne 拉臂邀婚礼「像姐妹」；Rue 内白：Horewith 死得太少——愿母亲一根根拔他肋骨、确保永罚；Anne 突然拥抱——「I do not embrace her back. I cannot. I do not quite know how.」
